scope: Finite real-socket native CBOR acceptance on 100000 stable users in 6250 rooms of 16. All bodies, sender IDs, FIFO and exact normal lifecycles checked; pressure sidecar uses exact input/reuse/lifecycle checks and explicitly bounded intentionally cancelled output. Ordinary trials run sequentially with no overlapping build, profile or load. CPU profiles are diagnostic only. Source/binary bindings distinguish historical client generations and the selected final post-workload routing proof. No hosted TLS/WAN/multi-hour capacity claim.

selected_build.operating_profile: 16 KiB send / 64 KiB receive, selected after the near-64KiB packet latency check.

rejected_cache.decision: Removed. Dense-flow gain did not carry to 100000-user overload: +1.57% median CPU/completed message and lower median achieved rate.

import hashlib,json,re,shutil,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
destination=root/'docs/benchmarks';prefix='2026-10-16-'
paths=[root/'artifacts'/f'{name}.json' for name in ['capacity-100k-before-2','capacity-100k-cache-1','capacity-100k-heartbeats-churn','capacity-100k-selected-waves','capacity-100k-selected-idle-pressure','capacity-100k-kernel-profile-full','capacity-100k-kernel-profile-idle','capacity-100k-kernel-control-idle','capacity-100k-final-postcheck','capacity-100k-profile-before','capacity-100k-rate10-eight-workers','capacity-final-ci','capacity-profile-startup','capacity-live','capacity-max-frame','capacity-100k-final-rx64-full','capacity-rx64-ci','capacity-large-frame-ci']]
paths+=sorted((root/'artifacts').glob('capacity-large-s*-r*.json'))
paths+=sorted((root/'artifacts').glob('capacity-100k-rate10-before-*.json'))+sorted((root/'artifacts').glob('capacity-100k-rate10-cache-*.json'))
paths+=sorted(p for p in (root/'artifacts').glob('recipient-cache-*.json') if re.search(r'-(before|cache)-[123]\.json$',p.name))
record={'base_revision':json.loads((root/'artifacts/baselines/capacity-final/build.json').read_text())['base_revision'],'scope':'Finite real-socket native CBOR acceptance on 100000 stable users in 6250 rooms of 16. All bodies, sender IDs, FIFO and exact normal lifecycles checked; pressure sidecar uses exact input/reuse/lifecycle checks and explicitly bounded intentionally cancelled output. Ordinary trials run sequentially with no overlapping build, profile or load. CPU profiles are diagnostic only. Source/binary bindings distinguish historical client generations and the selected final post-workload routing proof. No hosted TLS/WAN/multi-hour capacity claim.', 'selected_build':json.loads((root/'artifacts/baselines/capacity-final/build.json').read_text()),'historical_builds':{name:json.loads((root/'artifacts/baselines'/name/'build.json').read_text()) for name in ['recipient-cache','capacity-v2','kernel-acceptance-v3']},'traces':[],'passed':False}
for path in paths:
 data=json.loads(path.read_text());assert data['passed'],path
 if 'server_exit_code' in data:assert data['server_exit_code']==data['client_exit_code']==0,path
 assert not data.get('forced_kill_pids') and not data.get('server_forced_kill'),path
 target=destination/(prefix+path.name);shutil.copy2(path,target)
 record['traces'].append({'path':str(target.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(target),'server_sha256':data.get('server_sha256'),'client_sha256':data.get('client_sha256'),'diagnostic':data.get('profile_diagnostic',False)})
assert not (root/'src/relay/cache_tests.rs').exists()
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','--','src'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
assert not changed or changed==['src/config.rs','src/server.rs','src/server/arena_tests.rs'],changed
cache=root/'artifacts/baselines/recipient-cache'
record['rejected_cache']={'patch':(cache/'runtime.patch').read_text(),'focused_tests':(cache/'src/relay/cache_tests.rs').read_text(),'study':json.loads((root/'artifacts/recipient-cache-study.json').read_text()),'decision':'Removed. Dense-flow gain did not carry to 100000-user overload: +1.57% median CPU/completed message and lower median achieved rate.'}
for name in ['src/config.rs','src/server.rs','src/server/arena_tests.rs','examples/capacity.rs','examples/stress.rs','scripts/capacity.py','scripts/capacity_pressure.py']:
 assert sha(root/name)==record['selected_build']['files'][name],name
record['selected_runtime_patch']=(root/'artifacts/baselines/capacity-final/runtime.patch').read_text()
record['diagnostic_files']={name:sha(root/'artifacts'/name) for name in ['capacity-100k-profile-before.perf.data','capacity-100k-profile-before-flat.txt','capacity-100k-profile-before-receive-asm.txt']}
